wire.headline: Energy Firm Cuts Jobs and Closes Plants Amid Profit Decline
sentences: The company reported that its revenue rose 7% year on year to reach 4.26bn GBP for the quarter to 30 September.
During the same period, pre-tax profit fell by 12% to 310m GBP.
The firm announced plans to cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027, with one located in Wales and the other in Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held steady at 12.4p a share.
Shares dropped by 4.2% in morning trading.
